name: general_v1
description: Frozen general Japanese retrieval benchmark: JQaRA dev subset (open corpus of the sampled queries' candidate passages) + JaGovFaqs-22k subset + committed synthetic multi-format cases. Large public data is not committed; build it deterministically with scripts/run_general_benchmark.py build, then pin once with --pin and commit this file.

jqara_dev.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (JQaRA, hotchpotch/JQaRA; passages from Japanese Wikipedia). Do not commit the data; reports may quote aggregate numbers.

fetch.command: huggingface-cli download hotchpotch/JQaRA --repo-type dataset --revision <revision> --local-dir data/external/jqara  # then point 'input' at the dev parquet file of that revision

jagovfaqs.license: CC-BY-4.0 (JaGovFaqs-22k, matsuxr/JaGovFaqs-22k; Japanese government FAQ pages). Do not commit the data.

fetch.command: huggingface-cli download matsuxr/JaGovFaqs-22k --repo-type dataset --revision <revision> --local-dir data/external/jagovfaqs  # data.jsonl with Question / Answer

jqara_dev.note: answerable only (q_ids without a label-1 passage are dropped before sampling)

pinning: On the measurement PC: fetch both datasets at the pinned revisions, run `python scripts/run_general_benchmark.py build --pin`, review the printed sha256/composition, commit MANIFEST.json. After that, build/run refuse any input or output whose sha256 differs.
